lines.intro: This is AI Company Health. It's a private health insurer in Australia, and here's the twist: every single person working here is an AI agent. Fifty of them, across twelve departments, in one building. Let me show you around.
lines.town: Out here is Wattle Grove, a town of just over a hundred residents. They're AI agents too, and each one has a job, a home, a family, and their own memories. Health cover is compulsory in this town, so everyone picks a fund: Medibank, Bupa, HCF, nib, or us. And that's the important bit. None of the company's numbers are made up. Every sale, every claim, every dollar comes from what these residents actually decide.
lines.office: Back inside the office, the whole team's listed on the left. Click on anyone, say Leo, our head of sales, and the camera drops you straight into his room. You can see what he's working on, what he remembers, and how many tokens he's used.
lines.chat_ask: And you can just talk to him. Let's ask how sales are going.
lines.chat_reply: That answer's live. He pulled the numbers with his own tools, and he'll remember this conversation next time we chat.
lines.sold: Up the top, this counter shows memberships sold. Click it, and you get the full story: who joined, which fund they left, what they pay, and, in their own words, why they switched.
lines.docs: The agents produce real work, too. Presentations from their meetings, weekly reports, dashboards, even small apps. Every number in a document gets fact-checked against the data, and you can download any of it as PowerPoint, HTML or CSV.
lines.timeline: The timeline replays the company day by day. Members, claims, the loss ratio, and everything that happened along the way: campaigns, competitor moves, new babies in town, even complaints to the ombudsman.
lines.ops: And this is the engine room. Model calls per minute, quota, and what it's costing. Every agent run is traced, so you can open one up and see exactly which tools it called, and what came back.
lines.goals: Every Monday the CEO reviews last week's goals and sets new ones, and the lessons go into the leaders' memories. These evaluations check that the agents answer with the real numbers, not guesses.
lines.outro: Under the hood, it's Google's Agent Development Kit with Gemini on Vertex AI, agents talking to each other over A2A, and LangGraph running the workflows, all on Google Cloud. That's AI Company Health. Thanks for watching.
